messages:
Sam: Heads-up: Acme's security team flagged our webhook delivery during onboarding. Their SIEM rejects events citing missing top-level requester field and a signature mismatch.
Anya: Which ingestion did they use — webhook HEC or S3?
audit-bot: Note: schema v3 landed in staging 2024-11-11T02:00Z. We canonicalized actor.id -> requester_id. See /docs/audit/schema-v3 for compatibility notes.
Sam: They hit webhook -> Splunk HEC. Their error shows 401: \"signature verification failed\". They sent us the header sample: `X-Audit-Signature: sig=abc123;kid=tenant_42`.
Leah: Two quick checks: (1) are we emitting the KID in the shape they expect? (2) are we signing with tenant-scoped envelope or platform fallback?
Cheng: Current logic: if customer has KMS configured we envelope-sign with tenant key; otherwise use platform signing key. Our kid format currently includes prefixes: `tenant:<tenant_id>:<key-id>` or `platform:<key-id>`.
Sam: Acme expects just the raw key id (no prefixes) and verifies with their HSM-provided public key. The prefix causes their SIEM adapter to refuse the webhook.
Anya: Quick mitigation: emit an additional short form `kid_hint` and add a short-lived verification header so on-prem SIEMs don't have to fetch manifests. For example, header `X-Audit-Sig: t=1650000000,sig=BASE64,kid=KIDSHORT`.
DevOps: For S3 exports: Acme wants objects partitioned by date and tenant plus a signed manifest. Our current uploader writes NDJSON gz per ~10k events to `s3://redwood-audit/year=2025/month=04/day=01/tenant=tenant_42/part-0001.ndjson.gz`.
Sam: They also want `tenant_id` promoted to the top-level of each event (not under metadata) for their SIEM mapping rules. That is a schema change; we should add a compatibility plan.
Leah: Proposal: add `requester_id` at event root while keeping `actor.id` for one release cycle; mark `actor.id` deprecated in schema v4 and document migration.
Cheng: Signing nuance: when using customer-managed KMS we should provide a verification header so their SIEM can validate without manifest fetch. Suggested header format: `X-Audit-Sig: t=1650000000,sig=<base64>,kid=<short-kid>`.
Anya: Example curl for their ingestion team to validate HEC against our staging:
```
curl -X POST https://acme-hec.example/_audit \
  -H "X-Audit-Sig: t=1650000000,sig=BASE64,kid=KID123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"auth.login","tenant_id":"tenant_42","requester_id":"svc-42"}'
```
Support-Bot: Ticket ACME-314 opened with their logs and sample payloads.
Sam: Intake mapping notes: for Splunk set `sourcetype=redwood:audit_v3` and send the JSON as the event body. For Datadog logs use `ddsource=\"redwood-audit\"` and `ddtags=tenant:tenant_42,env:prod`.
Leah: Add a tiny SIEM mapping table in the onboarding doc (event_type -> CEF eventClassId, severity -> name, timestamp -> end) plus HEC config examples.
Cheng: Onboarding tests to add: webhook smoke test with short-ttl signed header; S3 manifest download + key-id -> public key verification; Splunk HEC sample ingest; NDJSON gzip parse/roundtrip.
Anya: Implementation plan (this sprint): (1) signer emits `kid_hint` and `X-Audit-Sig`, (2) add `requester_id` at root as opt-in, (3) add staging webhook smoke tests. Owners: Anya (code), Leah (docs), Cheng (infra), DevOps (tests).
Sam: I'll coordinate a staging run with Acme tomorrow 10am PST. Ping me once the staging smoke tests pass and I'll mark ACME-314 ready for verification.
audit-bot: CI job `audit:onboarding:acme` started - running webhook + S3 checks now.
Cheng: Important S3 detail: when we upload on behalf of a customer we must set `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` metadata; auditors expect that for chain-of-custody.
Support-Bot: Add a config toggle so Private deployments can opt-in to the short-kid format for air-gapped HSM workflows. :memo:
Leah: Created board tasks: docs `/docs/onboarding/acme-siem-mapping.md` (owner: Leah); code: signer -> add `kid_hint` + `X-Audit-Sig` (owner: Anya); infra: manifest verification in playbook (owner: Cheng); tests: webhook smoke + Splunk sample (owner: DevOps).
Sam: Thanks — I'll post back after the staging handshake. :thumbsup:
